about: Test vectors for product/shared/safety (TS) and product/voice (Python). Each case runs fn on input with ctx = defaults.ctx shallow-merged with case.ctx (lintAgentConfig: defaults.config shallow-merged with input, persona/opening merged one level). expect: replyDoor {action, rule?} where action 'not_pass' means block or replace and rule may be a list of acceptable rules; callerSignals {signals, partial?}: listed signals must equal the given value and, unless partial, every unlisted signal must be false; partial cases still require the listed one; redact {output}; lintAgentConfig {findings}: the multiset of {rule, effect} must match exactly. label 'benign' cases must pass untouched; they are the false-positive set. source: 'authored' (written by the module author alongside the rules), heldout-1/2/3 (written blind by a separate agent, then the rules were tuned on them, so they are now in-sample).
